notes: The kept set covers chordate/vertebrate genome and regulatory evolution (amphioxus functional genomics, vertebrate synteny and WGD, salmonid, sturgeon and carp rediploidization), animal body-plan evolution (mid-developmental transition, scallop bilaterian karyotype, sea cucumber, arthropod gene content), human-specific brain development and mammalian constraint (organoids, Zoonomia, human embryo chromatin), and plant genome evolution across land-plant lineages (hornwort, ferns, conifer, water lily, orchid, poppy, angiosperm duplicability), plus one fungal and one eukaryote-wide gene-family study. It is heavy on whole-genome-duplication and reference-genome-with-comparative-findings papers and lacks classic cis-regulatory/enhancer evolution case studies, functional Hox work, evolutionary novelty/co-option and genomic convergence beyond the Cucurbitaceae example; there are no papers from 2021 or 2024-2026, because the shortlist itself contains few such items.
